test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

The interference of the police force would have controlled the situation.

options.text: The situation could have been controlled by the interference of the police force.
The situation would be controlled by the interference of the police force
The situation could be controlled by the interference of the police force.
The situation would have been controlled by the interference of the police force

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "The interference of the police force would have controlled the situation."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the situation" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "would have controlled" to "would have been controlled" (past perfect conditional passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "the interference of the police force."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The situation would have been controlled by the interference of the police force."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The situation could have been controlled by the interference of the police force." – Incorrect conditional form.
 
• **Option 2: **"The situation would be controlled by the interference of the police force." – Incorrect tense (simple conditional).
 
• **Option 3: **"The situation could be controlled by the interference of the police force." – Incorrect conditional form and tense.
